title: Recipe and Mixtape
premise: Petra Hartwell bakes feelings into bread—grief makes loaves dense, joy makes them rise too fast—and has spent seventeen years being nobody at Marigold High. When their best friend Devi vanishes, leaving only a keyring of keys that open doors all over town, Petra discovers each key unlocks a piece of a secret: Devi was mapping the town's oldest institution, the Kessler Foundation, which grants belonging to anyone who surrenders something essential. Following the trail, Petra learns the Foundation's power is fed by the 'forgotten'—people erased from memory once they give themselves away—and that Petra's own grandmother was one of its founders, her inheritance a recipe book whose final page is a contract. In the climax, Petra must choose between using the inheritance to restore Devi (and lose their own gift for baking feeling) or burning the recipe and rebuilding belonging the slow, human way; they burn it, Devi returns half-remembered but real, and Petra finally opens the locker.
about_author: Petra Quintana grew up above her family's panadería in Fresno, where she learned that bread remembers everything you bring to the kitchen. She writes stories about quiet kids with loud hearts and still burns the first batch of every bake on purpose.

chapters.title: The Locker Rule
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. Establishes Petra's invisible-kid survival strategy: head down, grades up, locker shut, feelings baked into bread instead of spoken. A tender scene baking with Devi after school shows their bond—and Devi's restlessness about 'the doors in this town.' Beat: cozy before the fall.

chapters.title: Seven Keys
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. Devi doesn't show for three days. Police shrug; parents assume runaway. Then a package arrives: Devi's keyring, seven keys, no note. The first key fits the Marigold library's basement archive—a room Petra has never seen despite years there. Beat: dread blooming under routine.

chapters.title: What the Archive Keeps
chapters.summary: Petra's POV, with flashbacks in Devi's voice via margin notes in an archive ledger. The keys map to Foundation properties; the ledger lists names crossed out so thoroughly the ink resists reading. Petra finds their grandmother's name, uncrossed. Beat: the past reaches up and grabs.

chapters.title: Bread That Remembers
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. Grief-baking goes wrong—loaves come out hollow, tasting of nothing. Grandma Rosa's recipe book surfaces from storage, its final page sealed with wax. First confrontation with Foundation recruiter Mr. Aldous Vane, who is unfailingly kind and utterly wrong. Beat: the offer you should refuse.

chapters.title: Key Four Opens a House
chapters.summary: Petra and reluctant ally Theo (Devi's ex) use key four on a shuttered house where they find Devi's jacket and a wall of photos—residents of the Foundation's 'Belonging Program,' smiling identically. One photo shows a woman who looks exactly like Petra. Beat: horror wearing a welcome mat.

chapters.title: The Identical Smile
chapters.summary: Alternating POV: Petra investigating, Devi's fragmented present-tense chapters inside the Foundation, warm and foggy, memories dissolving like sugar in water. Devi can't remember why they wanted to leave. Beat: the villain's method revealed—it feels like home until it isn't.

chapters.title: Grandmother's Wax Seal
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. Breaking the seal reveals the contract: founder's descendants may reclaim anyone the Foundation holds by surrendering their own 'gift.' Petra tests the theory—bakes bread carrying a message only Devi could taste—and leaves it at key five's door. Beat: love as a weapon aimed at yourself.

chapters.title: Everything Rises
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. The message works: Devi wakes inside the Foundation, starts breaking things. But Vane escalates—he offers Petra full membership, power, permanent belonging, and the whole town's affection, showing how his own hunger corrupted him a century ago. Rising action peaks as Petra pretends to consider. Beat: temptation with teeth.

chapters.title: The Last Batch
chapters.summary: Petra's POV, climax. Inside the Foundation's heart—a kitchen that never stops feeding—Petra signs nothing, instead baking the inheritance itself into one final loaf and setting the recipe book aflame in the ovens. The building's spell cracks; the forgotten pour out remembering their names; Vane crumbles into the erasure he dealt. Devi stumbles out half-remembered, holding Petra's hand. Beat: sacrifice without martyrdom.

chapters.title: Open Locker
chapters.summary: Petra's POV, resolution. Weeks later: Devi relearning themselves over burnt toast, the town slowly unlearning its comfortable forgetting, Petra's bread plain and imperfect and shared. Final image—Petra opens the locker, tapes Devi's photo inside, and hands out warm rolls in the hallway to everyone, named. Beat: belonging chosen, not granted.
